name: Preflight Validation Hooks
description: Auto-run safety checks before shipping changes to bot runtime or trading logic

PreToolUse.command: bash -c 'if [[ "$FILE_PATH" =~ src/(trading|api|bot_instance_manager|main_instance)\.py ]]; then echo "Preflight: Checking imports and syntax..."; .venv/bin/python -m py_compile "$FILE_PATH" 2>&1 | head -20 || exit 1; fi'
PreToolUse.description: Validate Python syntax for runtime files

PostToolUse.command: bash -c 'if [[ "$FILE_PATH" =~ src/.*\.py ]]; then echo "Preflight: Running import check..."; .venv/bin/python -c "import ast; ast.parse(open(\"$FILE_PATH\").read())" 2>&1 || echo "WARNING: Syntax check failed"; fi'
